name: Greymatter
description: Context engine plugin — bounds per-turn message history via intelligent slicing. Fixes unbounded contents growth in long-running sessions.

recentTurnCount.description: How many most-recent messages to keep verbatim per turn.

preserveFirstUserMessage.description: Always keep the very first user message in the sliced output.

minRawFloor.description: Never prune below this many messages even if recentTurnCount is larger than available.

maxInjectedChars.description: Soft cap on systemPromptAddition chars. Newest content kept on overflow.

memoryBlockSource.description: How to source the injected memory block. 'memory-core': rely on OpenClaw's memory-core to inject MEMORY.md (default, safest). 'file': read MEMORY.md IO_LIVE section directly. 'none': no injection.

memoryRoot.description: Path to memory root dir (used only when memoryBlockSource=file).

memoryFile.description: Path to MEMORY.md (used only when memoryBlockSource=file).

debug.description: Emit per-turn debug log line with stats.
